scheme_name: Riyaayati Dar Par Copies Ka Vitaran
other_conditions: Construction workers must be employed in industrial units or establishments within the circle's jurisdiction.
Benefit is limited to a maximum of two children per worker.
The worker must deposit the cost of copies with the managing institution before distribution.
benefits_summary: Provides up to 10 small copies at ₹10 each and 10 registers at ₹14 each to children of construction workers.
